title: redact keeps the tail of an escaped-JSON secret value after a nested escaped quote
goal: redact replaces the whole value of an escaped-JSON secret assignment whose value holds a nested escaped quote ({\"password\": \"a\\\"b...\"}), at each escape level, and a second pass changes nothing. SP-g4mwrwsv review gap 1: the escaped-quote alternatives of ASSIGNMENT (_tools/redact.py) end the value at the first backslash run before a quote, so the part after a nested escaped quote stays.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import redact as R;b=chr(92);q=chr(34);v="kePass"+"12345x";t="{"+b+q+"pass"+"word"+b+q+": "+b+q+"a"+b+b+b+q+"b"+v+b+q+"}";o=R.redact(t);print(o);sys.exit(1 if v in o else 0)
